entry.title: Tenstorrent CEO on New Funding Round, AI Progress
entry.summary: Tenstorrent CEO Jim Keller discussed the chip startup’s $1.5 billion funding round, which values the company at about $6.2 billion. He said the company is focused on scaling its Galaxy server program and developing AI intellectual property, rather than pursuing a sale. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Bailey Lipschultz on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: JPMorgan's 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions
entry.summary: David Kelly, chief global strategist at JPMorgan Asset Management, and Stephen Parker, co-head of global investment strategy at JPMorgan Private Bank, discuss their latest Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions report, which projects about 7% annual returns for 60/40 portfolios over the next 10–15 years. They speak on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Goldman's Lynam Isn't Worried About Access to Debt Amid AI Buildout
entry.summary: Amanda Lynam, chief credit strategist at Goldman Sachs, says recent widening in AI-related credit spreads resembles an earlier episode but differs because high-yield debt is now leading the move and investors are raising fundamental questions. She speaks on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: AI Firm Nscale Faces Investor Pushback Over IPO Valuation
entry.summary: Bloomberg's Brody Ford said that issues facing the IPO of AI firm Nscale are 'endemic' to the larger AI data center industry as developers try to source power and labor and contend with potential delays. Bloomberg's Bailey Lipschultz said that the tone has shifted for AI IPOs as more companies slow down on going public before the end of the year. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Musk pledges to give ‘every kid in America’ one of his SpaceX shares
entry.summary: Musk's post came just a few hours after Anthropic promised to put 5% of its shares into a new "public benefit fund," which it intends to use to make "large donations to traditional nonprofits or direct distributions to specific populations" after its upcoming IPO.

entry.title: Chip Startup Tenstorrent Raises Funds at $6.2 Billion Value
entry.summary: AI chip startup Tenstorrent Inc., after attracting takeover interest earlier this year, has raised $1.5 billion from investors in a funding round that boosts its valuation to $6.2 billion.

entry.title: Korea Data Center IPO to Test AI Investor Resolve After Tumult
entry.summary: Data-center infrastructure company Elice Inc. is poised to debut on South Korea’s tech-heavy Kosdaq market Tuesday, testing AI investors’ nerves after peer Firmus canceled its high-profile listing this month.

entry.title: JP Morgan Strategist on AI Jitters, Investing Outlook
entry.summary: Jordan Jackson, JPMorgan Asset Management Global Market Strategist, discusses whether earnings growth may be nearing a peak even if results are not worsening. Jackson agrees that third-quarter results are expected to be strong, with forecasts calling for about 27% to 28% year-over-year earnings growth. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Kristine Aquino on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: Financing The AI Boom: Masters in Business with Bob Michele
entry.summary: Barry speaks with Bob Michele, CIO and Head of Global Fixed Income, Currency, and Commodities at JPMorgan. They discuss Bob's unconventional start at the University of Pennsylvania, the differences between the science of bonds and the art of equities, and whether the US is heading toward a recession. (Source: Bloomberg)

entry.title: SoftBank Is Said to Weigh Buying Top US Security Firm Allied
entry.summary: SoftBank Group Corp. is considering an acquisition of Allied Universal, the largest security services company in the US, people familiar with the matter said, as founder Masayoshi Son explores ways to deploy AI-powered robots across industries.
